name: ShUM Sites of Speyer, Worms and Mainz
description: In three medieval Rhine cities, Speyer, Worms and Mainz, this site preserves the roots of Ashkenazi Jewish life in Europe. You can step down into the stone mikveh (ritual bath) at Speyer, visit Worms' rebuilt 12th-century synagogue, and walk among the crowded gravestones of the old Jewish cemeteries in Worms and Mainz. Together they show a community that flourished from the 11th to the 14th centuries.
